tooQuiet: Too quiet. Sing a little louder, or move closer to the microphone.
allow: Allow the microphone when your browser asks.
openInBrowser: The browser built into this app can't use the microphone. Open this page in Chrome or Safari instead.
privacyLine: Nothing is recorded or sent. Your browser listens on your device, and the microphone turns off when you press Stop.
noScript: This tool needs JavaScript. Everything else on this page works without it.
